intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Vacaville for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Santa and Mrs. Claus at Silveyville Farm in Dixon) through January 3, 2027 (Winter Wonderland on Ice at Vacaville Ice Sports), with Merriment on Main (December 1), the Holiday Festival at Nut Tree and Santa Arrival at Vacaville Commons (both December 5), the Solano Symphony Orchestra Holiday Celebration (December 6) and Breakfast with Santa (December 12) along the way, plus the Downtown Dixon Christmas Tree Lighting Festival (December 5). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Vacaville

  • 11 Christmas events for kids in Vacaville and Dixon
  • 2 free events: the Holiday Festival at Nut Tree and Santa Arrival at Vacaville Commons
  • Meet Santa: Merriment on Main (December 1), the Holiday Festival at Nut Tree and Santa Arrival at Vacaville Commons (December 5), Pancakes with Santa in Dixon (December 5), Breakfast with Santa (December 12) and Santa at Silveyville Farm (November 27 to December 13)
  • Parades, tree lightings and music: Christmas in My Hometown (November 28), the Merriment on Main tree lighting (December 1), the Downtown Dixon Christmas Tree Lighting Festival (December 5) and the Solano Symphony Orchestra Holiday Celebration (December 6)
  • Rides: train and carriage rides at Merriment on Main (December 1) and ice skating at Winter Wonderland on Ice (December 11 to January 3, 2027)
  • Season: November 27 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Vacaville families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Sacramento, which covers the Imaginarium at Cal Expo, Theatre of Lights and the Old Sacramento Tree Lighting.
